basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old music enthusiast living in the vibrant city of Pittsburgh. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, often juggling multiple projects from my cozy home office. My interest in alternative music genres like J-pop and metal led me to discover BABYMETAL, and I frequently visit their subreddit to stay updated. I enjoy exploring new music and occasionally perform at local open mic nights. In my free time, I delve into poetry, contributing to the 'rapidinhapoetica' subreddit. My evenings are often spent online, usually between 6 PM and midnight. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom of exploring new hobbies and meeting new people.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design, which I honed through a combination of formal education and self-teaching. I hold a bachelor's degree in Fine Arts from a local university and have been working freelance for the past three years. Additionally, my interest in music and poetry has led me to develop a broad understanding of various music genres and poetic styles.
